annotations.title: Project bootstrapped
annotations.body: Local app, GitHub repo, Codex workflow, and README setup completed.

annotations.title: Realtime transcription fixed
annotations.body: Changed Realtime URL/session shape and omitted unsupported VAD for gpt-realtime-whisper.

annotations.title: Translation and exports confirmed
annotations.body: Translations work and Copy, TXT, and JSON exports include original text and translations clearly.

annotations.title: Local session saving confirmed
annotations.body: Saved sessions work with text-only transcript storage, open, delete, and persistence after page refresh. Audio is intentionally not stored yet.

annotations.title: Manual QA and friendly errors confirmed
annotations.body: The QA checklist passed, friendly startup/browser-facing error messages work, and the app stayed stable after the reliability pass.

annotations.title: Product UX polish confirmed
annotations.body: The notification, layout balance, controls, transcript readability, and saved sessions remain usable, and the caption engine still works.

annotations.title: Multilingual and accent robustness confirmed
annotations.body: Auto detect works, specific language hints improve accuracy, translation to English works, and the unsupported Realtime Whisper prompt bug was fixed. Vocabulary boost remains visible but is documented as not guaranteed for the current model.

annotations.title: Private beta prep docs created
annotations.body: BETA_TESTER_GUIDE.md, KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md, FEEDBACK_QUESTIONS.md, and DEMO_CHECKLIST.md were added. README links to all four. No app code changed.

annotations.title: Public Display Mode confirmed
annotations.body: The public display/kiosk mode now keeps the main caption updated with the latest live text, includes a working history option, avoids cropping, and keeps the privacy notice visible.

annotations.title: Offline Android device path documented
annotations.body: ANDROID_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PLAN.md captures the future native Android, whisper.cpp, bundled tiny.en, offline-first physical-device direction. This remains planned, not active.

pipeline.title: First private tester session
pipeline.description: Choose one trusted tester, run DEMO_CHECKLIST.md, share the tester docs, and capture feedback. Include Public Display Mode if relevant.

pipeline.title: Triage tester feedback
pipeline.description: Separate feedback into bugs, confusing UX, accuracy issues, public-display feedback, and future ideas. Fix only the highest-value small items first.

pipeline.title: Small private beta
pipeline.description: After the first tester session is understood, invite a small group and repeat the same feedback process.

pipeline.title: Desktop overlay
pipeline.description: Build a floating caption bar for meetings and videos after the web app is stable and tester feedback supports it.

pipeline.title: Offline Android physical device
pipeline.description: Explore a native Android app with local whisper.cpp only after the web/kiosk product is validated.

risks.risk: Session data only lives in the browser for now
risks.mitigation: Keep export buttons and clearly document that localStorage is local-only.
Only one Codex task at a time; do not start database, login, desktop overlay, or Android app until beta feedback is reviewed.
Keep translation on final transcripts only and check OpenAI billing before demos.
Use Chrome as the primary test browser before Safari/Edge.

risks.risk: Auto detect can misidentify short phrases or place names
risks.mitigation: Guide users to choose a specific language hint when they know the spoken language.

risks.risk: Tester feedback may be too broad
risks.mitigation: Use FEEDBACK_QUESTIONS.md and ask testers to focus on setup, accuracy, translation, exports, saved sessions, and public display.
Prioritize readability, large fonts, keyboard access, public-display readability, and real user feedback.

risks.risk: Offline Android device assumptions are untested
risks.mitigation: Keep the Android physical-device track as planned only until cheap-tablet performance is tested with whisper.cpp.
